facts.scope_summary: Support ChatPro Phase 3 for PPG by assessing the current platform, completing data readiness work, and implementing new procurement intelligence capabilities on top of the existing production platform. Scope includes demand and price forecasting integration, should-cost, supplier and pricing analytics, alternative supplier identification, supply risk and opportunity identification, AI-driven decision support, and export-ready business outputs with source/date/confidence transparency.
in_scope: Data Readiness and AI Readiness Scorecard
Executive Summary Presentation for Steering Committee review
Business-friendly outputs suitable for Excel and PowerPoint
User-facing transparency into source, date, and confidence
Guidance when required information is missing or incomplete
Multi-agent layer, guardrails and confidence model
Application, workspace, Genie orchestration and exports
Hypercare, tuning and value register activation
out_of_scope: No active-active replication is planned for this phase
Data mesh is not required today for Phase 3
The innovation agenda in Section 13 is explicitly post-go-live
Should-cost coverage at go-live is a prioritized material set rather than the full portfolio

commercials: Pricing model: Not-to-exceed fixed fee by milestone, aligned to the 22-week plan
Assessment complete and scope locked (W5): USD 83,182
Feature complete and code freeze (W18): USD 67,673
Sizing the opportunity (illustrative): on PPG’s $10B managed annual spend, every 1% realized should-cost closure ≈ $100M gross opportunity
assumptions: The existing Azure and Databricks landscape is available and reused without architectural change
Mosaic AI capabilities — Agent Framework, Model Serving, Foundation Model APIs, Vector Search, Genie — are enabled with capacity for the projected workload
Environments and CI/CD are extendable to agent, prompt, semantic and evaluation artifacts
Platform capacity and cost for additional compute, serving and storage is provisioned by the client
Access to ERP purchase order, invoice, contract, material master, BoM and routing data
The demand forecast is a consumable feed at a defined grain, horizon and cadence, with history to assess accuracy
The price forecast is consumable, or index series are licensed such that a forward price can be modeled
Internal cost model logic, conversion and yield assumptions, and the PPG hierarchy are available
Required external subscriptions are held or procured, with license terms permitting the intended use
A client product owner with authority to prioritize and sign off
Subject matter experts — managers, planners, cost analysts, stewards — available at an agreed cadence
AD groups and role definitions agreed with security; Unity Catalog entitlements configured
Security, architecture and governance review points scheduled in advance, off the critical path
Source-of-truth hierarchy confirmed and delivered by PPG's ChatPro team before build begins
Data completeness gaps identified in the Data Quality Assessment addressed by PPG before go-live
Early Category Manager engagement to validate and refine LLM-generated should-cost starting points
SME availability for prompt validation, cost-model review, and output sign-off designated by PPG
Confidence-scoring methodology agreed jointly during design, not retrofitted after UAT
UAT structured around Exhibit A's predefined prompts, graded by category managers
Early CARB engagement and approval for any component outside PPG's approved stack
Three Category Managers at roughly four hours a week each are available during weeks 3 to 20
Security and architecture review slots at weeks 5, 8 and 19 are pre-booked and combined into single sessions
At every gate, decisions returned within three business days
Scope frozen at the week-5 gate; later changes go to a post-go-live backlog
